my_detections.logic: EXE started from a 10-hex-character folder (Amadey install path)
rundll32 loading cred64.dll / clip64.dll (Amadey plugin names)
schtasks.exe /Create every minute from a user folder
fDenyTSConnections=0 set by a process in a user-writable path
User Shell Folders\Startup redirected away from the Start Menu
hex-folder EXE + every-minute task on the same host
new local admin + new firewall rule on the same host
4698/4702 task whose action is in a user-writable path or an every-minute interpreter
schtasks /create|/change with a user-writable or every-minute interpreter action
